name: RetailLens
title: RetailLens - SAP S/4HANA Order-to-Cash Case Study on Real Retail Orders
summary: Case study: about 100K real Olist e-commerce orders (Kaggle, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0) mapped into SAP S/4HANA SD tables (KNA1, MARA, VBAK/VBAP, LIKP/LIPS, BSAD); data-quality gates on real issues, CDS-style star schema, SQL KPIs (OTIF, lead-time stages, payment approval, complaint and cancellation rates), Power BI DAX model, Streamlit dashboard and a consultant insights report.
data: Real: Olist Brazilian E-Commerce Public Dataset (Kaggle olistbr/brazilian-ecommerce), CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, non-commercial. Exact counts and KPI values in metrics.json
